name: Jan Moller
reason: Mainly clinical and therapy work: his own site (https://janmoller.com/jan-moller/) presents him as a physician, psychotherapist and health educator whose work is aimed at mental health, and his individual sessions page offers psychotherapy and describes treating stress and anxiety conditions, depression, psychosomatic conditions and chronic pain, plus psychedelic integration talks; almost nothing passes the health rule. (A contact form exists at https://janmoller.com/kontakt/.)
